resources.string: Every phone is a listening sensor

ARMED · This phone will wake up as a rescue sensor when rescuers probe for it, even with the app closed and the screen off. Battery cost: near zero.\n\nYou can close the app now, or pick a role for a live session.
ARMED, BUT NOT YET ALLOWED IN THE BACKGROUND · On this phone the wake-up only works when Hush is exempt from battery optimisation. Tap the button below and choose Allow.
ALLOW HUSH IN THE BACKGROUND (needed for the wake-up)
Notifications are off for Hush: the rescue alert would not be shown. Allow them in Settings → Apps → Hush → Notifications.
Full-screen alerts are off for Hush: a woken phone will show a small notification instead of the red rescue screen. Allow "full-screen notifications" for Hush in Settings.
